note: One recommended PvE build per path. Ratings treat each one, at max Inner Way tiers, as 100. recommendedTier is the guides' advice on where to stop upgrading; it isn't used by the rating.

builds.name: Sword Morph volley (PvE)

innerWays.note: Safest third slot; Tier 5 is enough if materials are short.
Core for PvE now; upgrade second.

alternatives: Hawkwing is the simpler weapon set; Jadeware is the optimized PvE pick and triggers on a Qi-Imbalanced boss

builds.why: Charge Vagrant Sword behind a Qi shield for sword-energy volleys; the spear's Qiankun's Lock sets up Qi Imbalance on the boss and cuts Endurance costs.
builds.rotation: Spear first for Qi Imbalance, then chain Vagrant Sword volleys within 5s of each other. Dragon Head fills when Endurance is low; Dragon's Breath into Drunken Poet when the boss opens up.
alternatives: Adaptive Steel or Wildfire Spark in the fourth slot
Insightful Strike (Tier 5+) instead of Morale Chant for an Affinity-stacked build
1v1 PvP: Sword Morph, Morale Chant, Fury Harvest, Evasive Charge
builds.agreement: Both sources list the same four Inner Ways. They disagree on the weapon set: wherewindsmeetgame.org leads with Hawkwing, Game8 with Jadeware.

builds.name: Bleed burst (PvE)

innerWays.note: Much better at high tiers; raise Morale Chant first if materials are short.

alternatives: Eaglerise armor (Bleed keeps its stacks up)
Strong offensive armor rolls can beat a full armor set

builds.why: Stack 5 Bleed with the Strategic Sword, cash it in with Sword Horizon's High Bleeding, and keep Sober Sorrow's combo buffs up with the spear.
builds.rotation: Build Bleed, time Crisscrossing Swords follow-ups, keep Sober Sorrow's combo count high. Swap Dragon Head for Soaring Spin or Cloud Steps when the boss moves.
alternatives: Invigorated Warrior until Insightful Strike is upgraded
Bitter Seasons or Fivefold Bleed for extra DoTs
builds.agreement: Both sources list the same four Inner Ways and Hawkwing + Flawless Defense.

builds.name: Rodents and Flamelash (PvE)

innerWays.note: Best at Tier 6 when you burst Exhausted targets.

alternatives: Swallowcall + Calmwaters for everyday content and PvP

builds.why: Keep the Mortal Rope Dart's rats running (about 40% of boss damage) while the Twinblades' Flamelash Light Attacks do most of the rest.
builds.rotation: Rope dart setup for Rodent Rampage, then Twinblade Flamelash chains. Use Mystic Arts in rope-dart setup or Flamelash downtime, not in the middle of a strong chain.
alternatives: Vital Leech in the fourth slot (Game8's pick), swapping Breaking Point in for Exhausted bursts
builds.agreement: Three Inner Ways agree. Fourth slot: wherewindsmeetgame.org (Nov 5, 2026) picks Breaking Point, Game8 (Sep 3) picks Vital Leech. We use Breaking Point, the newer pick; Vital Leech is the listed alternative.
verifyNotes: Sources disagree on the fourth Inner Way (Breaking Point vs Vital Leech).

Better than Blade's Will on single bosses.
